entity_types.name: Organization
entity_types.selection_rule: 能决策或发声的非政府机构，如央行部门、市场中介、交易平台、研究机构
entity_types.description: Non-governmental institutions: Fed desks, dealers, platforms, research bodies

attributes.name: influence_tier
attributes.description: high/medium/low influence on the forecast outcome

examples: Primary dealers and Treasury market hedge funds

entity_types.name: Government
entity_types.selection_rule: 拥有主权政策杠杆的政府机构/部门：财政部、国会、外国官方机构
levers: 调整季度再融资券种规模
买卖外汇储备/美债持仓
entity_types.description: Sovereign fiscal/monetary authorities: Treasury, Congress, foreign officials

entity_types.name: CentralBank
entity_types.selection_rule: 负责设定政策利率与资产负债表规则的货币当局
levers: 调整储备管理购买规模与期限
entity_types.description: Monetary policy authorities setting rates and balance-sheet rules

entity_types.name: Person
entity_types.selection_rule: 以个人身份行动且其信号影响市场定价的领导者
levers: 国会证词与讲话指引预期
entity_types.description: Individual leaders whose signaling moves rate expectations

entity_types.name: Platform
entity_types.selection_rule: 聚集市场定价并被各方引用的交易/数据平台
entity_types.description: Market-pricing aggregation platforms feeding the expected-rate component

entity_types.name: TreasuryInstrument
entity_types.selection_rule: 被预测或被交易的具名证券/标的（DGS10、券种组合）
anti_examples: 抽象的'收益率曲线'概念
entity_types.description: The forecast target and related Treasury securities/issuance mix
examples: Nominal coupon and FRN auction complex

entity_types.name: MacroIndicator
entity_types.selection_rule: 可追踪的具体指标序列（期限溢价、Sahm、盈亏平衡通胀等）
entity_types.description: Trackable signal series: term premium, breakevens, Sahm, deficit

edge_types.name: INFLUENCES
edge_types.direction_semantics: source 对 target 施加政策或定价影响（如Fed影响财政部发行决策、期货定价影响Fed沟通）
edge_types.description: Policy or pricing influence of one actor over another

edge_types.name: SUPPLIES
edge_types.direction_semantics: source 向 target 供应/发行证券（财政部向一级交易商供应新券）
edge_types.description: Treasury supplies new issues to dealers/intermediaries

edge_types.name: PARTNERS_WITH
edge_types.direction_semantics: source 与 target 协同（Fed主席与FOMC、BoJ与日本财务省）

edge_types.name: DEPENDS_ON
edge_types.direction_semantics: source 的操作依赖于 target 的政策框架（纽约联储市场台依赖FOMC决策）
edge_types.description: Operational dependency of one body on another's mandate

edge_types.name: INVESTS_IN
edge_types.direction_semantics: source 持有/投资 target 的证券（日本财务省、PBoC持有美债）
edge_types.description: Foreign official holdings of Treasury securities

edge_types.name: CUSTOMER_OF
edge_types.direction_semantics: source 是 target 的客户（财政部通过一级交易商分销新券）
edge_types.description: Treasury as distribution client of dealer intermediaries

edge_types.name: SUPPORTS
edge_types.direction_semantics: source 提供分析/数据支持 target 的决策（克利夫兰联储的衰退概率模型支撑FOMC决策输入）
edge_types.description: Analytical or data support feeding a decision body

edge_types.name: CAUSES
edge_types.direction_semantics: source 引起 target 的变动（政策路径/发行量驱动指标变动）
edge_types.description: Causal transmission from actor action to indicator/instrument move

edge_types.name: CONSTRAINS
edge_types.direction_semantics: source 约束 target 的变动空间（历史基率、冻结券种规模限制收益率突破幅度）
edge_types.description: Factors bounding the outcome's move (base rates, issuance freezes)

edge_types.name: TRIGGERS
edge_types.direction_semantics: source 越过阈值后触发 target 对应情景（Sahm≥0.50触发衰退情景）
edge_types.description: Threshold crossings that activate a scenario branch

analysis_summary: 该预测问题是纯市场/宏观客体问题：以FRED DGS10在2027-12-31的定盘为标的，核心传导机制为（1）Fed政策路径与资产负债表规则锁定预期利率成分，（2）财政部发行结构与CBO赤字基线通过期限溢价施压，（3）日本/中国官方需求影响边际买盘，（4）衰退概率决定尾部。本体保留actor阵容种子类型（Organization/Government/Person/Platform）并新增CentralBank以突出货币政策当局的裁决地位；客体与信号侧新增TreasuryInstrument（DGS10标的）与MacroIndicator（期限溢价、Sahm、盈亏平衡等可追踪信号）。关系在实证边（INFLUENCES/SUPPLIES/PARTNERS_WITH/DEPENDS_ON/INVESTS_IN/CUSTOMER_OF/SUPPORTS）之上增加CAUSES/CONSTRAINS/TRIGGERS因果边，携带sign/lag/strength/threshold属性，把图谱从主体索引升级为冲击传导模型，直接服务于四情景（高原40%/熊陡20%/通缩25%/衰退15%）的概率推演。
